I’m using wBlock for macOS, which in turn makes use of the _AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter_. It would seem that if you have the AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter enabled and if then you try to log in at maccosmetics.com, Safari ends up in a redirect loop, and you get a “Too many redirects” error. **Steps to reproduce the behavior:** 1. First, enable the AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter in your ad blocker of choice. 2. Then open https://www.maccosmetics.com/ in Safari on macOS. 3. And then click on the avatar icon in the top right on the page to try to load the MAC Cosmetics login screen. * Expected behavior MAC Cosmetics’ login page loads. * Actual behavior: Safari ends up in a redirect loop, and you get a “Too many redirects” error. 2. Screenshots I like buying makeup from MAC Cosmetics, so when I first came across this issue, I individually disabled the filters in app one by one until I found the one that was causing the issue (which in this case turned out to be the _AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter_). And I was able to confirm that once I disabled that filter, I could load the login page at maccosmetics.com. ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition
